description.value: Ridgeway Spirits is a private liquor store on Lougheed Highway at the corner of Laity Street in Maple Ridge, operated by the Springs Group network of 13-plus BC liquor stores and brew pubs. The store focuses on craft beer, wine, and spirits with a stated emphasis on quality selection and community service. Curbside pickup and home delivery are available in addition to in-store shopping.

address.value: 21280 Lougheed Highway, Maple Ridge, BC V2X 2R7

enrichment_extras.reasoning: Website content confirms Ridgeway is a real, operating private liquor store at 21280 Lougheed Highway, Maple Ridge, part of the Springs Group chain. The site calls it 'Ridgeway Liquor Store' and 'Ridgeway Beer Wine Spirits (BWS)' — differing from the OSM name 'Ridgeway Spirits' — which is flagged in concerns. Phone, address, and email all match OSM. No cycling-specific amenities (bike parking, washrooms, water) are mentioned anywhere on the website.
concerns: Name mismatch: OSM records the store as 'Ridgeway Spirits' but the Springs Group website consistently calls it 'Ridgeway Liquor Store', 'Ridgeway BWS', and 'Ridgeway Beer Wine Spirits'. OSM name retained per rules.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: A real, open, publicly accessible liquor store on a major highway corridor in Maple Ridge, useful to touring cyclists for resupply.
